reason: The report's estimate comes from only the north subsample (N=642) and a trimmed outcome, which it chose without justification. On the full sample with the same pre-period controls, the remote_share effect is 0.75 (SE 0.23, p=0.001), and the central and south regions show similar positive effects, so 'no effect' reflects subsample selection. The pre-period outcome is controlled, and I found no post-treatment control in the report's specification, though collab_index_2023 is post-period and should stay out of the controls.
